Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting files and folders including user home directories and Oracle database directories on Linux servers
Uses RC4 encryption with a hardcoded master key vulnerable to decryption
Attempts to elevate permissions to encrypt data
Targets specific directories such as /home, /root, /opt, /u01 to /u04
Lacks proper obfuscation and evasiveness mechanisms
Encrypts files but encryption scheme is flawed allowing free decryption
Indicators of Compromise: Python decryptor script available on GitHub
Attack Vector: Malware executable launched on Linux systems with privilege escalation attempts
